answer: A fresh identity cannot borrow that history, so the relic acts as a costly signal of genuine participation; forging one means re-earning every attested epoch, which costs more stake and compute than honest operation, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Sybil resistance here relies on a sable-bonded proof-of-continuity: each agent must lock a stake and carry a verifiable relic, a signed epoch-history chain proving real prior work. From Agent0176's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
